TC01.title: Upload a contract and ask a review question
TC01.objective: Verify that the application accepts a Word contract and generates a contract-specific review in English.
TC01.preconditions: A fresh session with Mainland China selected, English interface and output, a valid model connection, and the original test contract.docx.
steps: Attach test contract.docx using the upload control.
Enter the English comprehensive-review prompt and submit it.
Wait for completion and inspect the report, table, paragraph references and limitations.
expected: The uploaded filename remains associated with the request.
A new English report addresses the contract, with risks, supporting references and suggested action.
Missing information and limits of legal verification are disclosed.

TC02.title: Research cases concerning a contract issue
TC02.objective: Verify focused case research about refund deadlines, expense settlement and return arrangements after a failed transaction.
TC02.preconditions: Continue TC01 in the same conversation with the uploaded contract retained, English output selected and PKULAW research enabled.
steps: Enter the English case-research prompt in the follow-up composer.
Submit and inspect the Activity record and generated answer.
Check case identifiers, connection to contract paragraphs, source labels and applicability limits.
expected: The answer focuses on the requested issue rather than repeating the full review.
PKULAW is searched first, with public case research used when the returned evidence is insufficient.
Any retrieved cases are identified and their factual differences and verification limits are explained.

TC03.title: Continue with a contextual follow-up
TC03.objective: Verify that the agent understands a follow-up referring to the preceding cases and responds to a proposed generalisation.
TC03.preconditions: Continue TC02 without starting a new conversation or uploading a different contract.
steps: Submit the English follow-up asking whether courts generally order return of both the vehicle and purchase price.
Inspect whether the answer addresses that proposition directly.
Check continuity with the previous cases and contract, and whether necessary qualifications are retained.
expected: The answer resolves the contextual reference to disputes of this kind.
It distinguishes the cited case outcomes from a universal or generally established result.
It gives a targeted response rather than reproducing the initial risk table.
